description: Local project GUI and read-only offline export. Workbench browser checks are separate from drawing-app native acceptance; native Zed and speech checks remain pending.

cases.expected: Seven destinations, filters, selection and Back preserve meaningful navigation.
Exact source and stale refresh remain visible; failed refresh retains the previous snapshot.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/bounds.test.ts:workbench failed refresh retains previous snapshot as stale
node:scripts/workbench/tests/adapters.test.ts:workbench bounds identity reads and rejects symlink escapes

cases.expected: Board validation, graph and table preserve task state; cycles remain readable without fabricated ordering.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/adapters.test.ts:bounded supplied board validation matches ordinary malformed and cycle validation

cases.expected: Offline document navigation renders hostile text inertly and keeps large documents bounded.
Dependency refresh never installs tools; the concise inventory retains resolved relationships and provenance in details.
Missing, invalid, stale and retry evidence stay distinct; invalid requirements are unavailable, never zero or passing.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/coverage-envelope.test.ts:workbench aggregate producer envelopes preserve failed retries and stale attempts
node:scripts/workbench/tests/adapters.test.ts:invalid board retains readable rows while malformed evidence is invalid
node:scripts/workbench/tests/bounds.test.ts:workbench rejects aggregate feature bounds and malformed partial evidence pairs

cases.expected: Only fixed background actions run; origin, capability, argument and checkout ownership violations are rejected.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/service.test.ts:workbench service rejects foreign origins capabilities foreground and second owners

cases.expected: Version 1 disables foreground actions in both GUI and service; no reservation or permission dialog can enable them.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/service.test.ts:workbench service rejects foreign origins capabilities foreground and second owners

cases.expected: Queue admission, cancellation, failure, timeout and output limits preserve truthful bounded job history.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/service.test.ts:workbench queue limits simultaneous admissions and cancellation before spawn
node:scripts/workbench/tests/service.test.ts:workbench real failed job stays failed with retained safe output
node:scripts/workbench/tests/completion.test.ts:workbench completion remains running and cancellation cannot become passed
node:scripts/workbench/tests/process.test.ts:owned workbench child preserves failure and terminates output floods
node:scripts/workbench/tests/process.test.ts:owned workbench cancellation waits for child cleanup
node:scripts/workbench/tests/process.test.ts:owned workbench timeout is not reported as success

cases.expected: An actual Wasm build draws on an isolated origin; immutable preview identity survives failed publication and never exposes admin capability.
testIds: node:scripts/workbench/tests/completion.test.ts:workbench previews serve frozen bytes and preserve old preview after failed publication

cases.expected: Missing metrics appear unavailable with scope and units, never a fabricated zero or quality ranking.
The real project exports through a background job and opens offline with the same UI and disabled execution, without session capabilities.
The installed Zed project task starts the service, exposes its URL and stops it cleanly.

gaps.reason: Project task definitions exist, but actual Zed launch is pending the owner's permission-free desktop window.

cases.expected: Keyboard selection, focus, narrow layouts and contrast remain usable; spoken accessibility requires its own native check.

gaps.reason: Headless keyboard and layout checks do not establish screen-reader speech quality.
